lines.en: label amidate50p3:
scene amidatecafe1
The portion of the day we spend in the entertainment district is mostly negligible, so I guess I can find solace in the fact that Ami isn’t suddenly lying to me about everything.
lines.zh: 今天我们待在娱乐街区的部分基本可以忽略不计,所以我还能从「Ami 并没有突然开始对我撒一切谎」这件事里找到一点安慰。

lines.en: I can also find solace in the fact that she has offered to pay for me despite me telling her multiple times that it isn’t necessary.
lines.zh: 另一个安慰是:尽管我说了好多次不必,她还是主动提出要替我付钱。

lines.en: But hey, who am I to refuse free food when it’s so kindly offered up?
lines.zh: 不过嘛,人家好意相赠的免费食物,我有什么资格拒绝?

lines.en: I’ve humored her enough to wind up beside her at some random cafe. Turning down an act of kindness now would make it appear like I have no desire to be here at all.
lines.zh: 我半推半就,最后和她坐在了某家随机的咖啡馆里。现在拒绝人家的好意,会显得我根本不想在这里。

lines.en: And, you know what? Now that the sad portion of the day is over, I really don’t hate this.
lines.zh: 而且,你猜怎么着?悲伤的部分结束后,我真的不讨厌这里。

lines.en: It’s nice being able to focus on what’s directly in front of me without needing to wrap my mind around any obnoxious subtext or deflect all of the horrible things I’ve done as they’re thrown back at my face.
lines.zh: 能专注看着眼前的东西,不用费心解读任何讨厌的潜台词、也不用把做过的种种破事一一挡回去,感觉真好。

lines.en: : So...I guess you and Molly made up?
lines.zh: : 所以……你和 Molly 和好了?

lines.en: At least I had a decent thirty minutes or so.
lines.zh: 至少我安生了差不多三十分钟。

lines.en: : Forget what happened between Molly and me. For a second back there, I thought you two were going to run away together.
lines.zh: : Molly 和我之间的事就别管了。刚才那一瞬间,我还以为你们俩要私奔了。

lines.en: scene amidatecafe2
: Huh? What gave you that idea?
lines.zh: : 嗯?你怎么会有这种想法?

lines.en: : Probably the part where your faces were touching and you were gazing into each other’s eyes.
lines.zh: : 大概因为你们俩脸贴着脸、四目相对吧。

lines.en: scene amidatecafe3
: Were you even listening to that conversation?! It was really sad! We were just having a cute bonding moment!
lines.zh: : 你到底有没有在听那段对话?!那明明很感人!我们只是在可爱地培养感情!

lines.en: : It would have been cuter if you two kissed.
lines.zh: : 你们要是亲上就让它更感人了。

lines.en: : You...don’t mean that! And stop deflecting! I still need to know what happened between you two since you never tell me anything anymore!
lines.zh: : 你……不是认真的!还有别打岔!我还是得知道你们俩之间发生了什么,因为你现在什么都不告诉我了!

lines.en: scene amidatecafe4
: You know I don’t have to tell you everything, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道的,我没有义务事事都向你汇报,对吧?

lines.en: : Yeah, but I tell you everything so it only seems fair if you maybe tell me some things every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 是,但我不都告诉你了吗?所以偶尔也许告诉我一点点,才算公平吧?

lines.en: : Nah. I'm good.
lines.zh: : 不。我挺好。

lines.en: scene amidatecafe5
: Fine. I’ll just ask her then since we’re making plans to hang out soon. She’ll tell me.
lines.zh: : 好。那我就去问她了,反正我们约好近期一起玩。她会告诉我的。

lines.en: : Just leave it alone, Ami. Please.
lines.zh: : 别掺和,Ami。拜托。

lines.en: scene amidatecafe6
: Please? But you never say please. Is it really that serious? Because you made it sound kinda unimportant the last time I asked you about it.
lines.zh: : 「拜托」?你从来不说「拜托」。有这么严重吗?上次我问你的时候,你搞得好像没那么要紧似的。

lines.en: : It’s just a personal matter that the two of us decided to handle on our own instead of enlisting the help of everyone else.
lines.zh: : 那只是我们俩决定私下处理的一件私事,不想麻烦所有人。

lines.en: scene amidatecafe7
: Personal?
lines.zh: : 私事?

lines.en: : That’s what I said.
lines.zh: : 我是这么说的。

lines.en: : Now, since we’re done talking about-
lines.zh: : 好,既然这个话题聊完了——

lines.en: : How personal, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 有多「私」,Sensei?

lines.en: : Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么?

lines.en: : What do you mean by “personal?” That makes it sound like you two have a relationship deeper than just teacher and student.
lines.zh: : 「私事」是什么意思?听起来你们俩的关系,已经深到不只是师生了吧。

lines.en: : Maybe we do?
lines.zh: : 也许吧?

lines.en: : Are you friends now?
lines.zh: : 你们现在是朋友了?

lines.en: : Sure. I guess so.
lines.zh: : 对,大概算。

lines.en: : Then how come you were avoiding her so much when it seemed like she needed you most? That doesn’t sound very friend-like.
lines.zh: : 那她看起来最需要你的时候,你为什么躲着她躲得那么厉害?这可不太像朋友。

lines.en: : Here’s a better idea- how about we eat and get back to our date? Doesn’t that sound good, Ami?
lines.zh: : 我有个更好的主意——我们吃饭,然后继续约会,怎么样?听起来不错吧,Ami?

lines.en: : No. You two stopped talking for two months and are now back to acting like nothing ever happened. I want to know what caused it.
lines.zh: : 不好。你们俩断了两个月联系,现在又装作什么都没发生。我想知道是什么导致的。

lines.en: : And I want you to mind your own business.
lines.zh: : 而我想要你管好你自己的事。

lines.en: : But your business is my business. I can’t make you happy if I don’t know how to get rid of what’s making you sad.
lines.zh: : 可你的事就是我的事。我要是不知道怎么除掉让你难过的东西,就没法让你开心。

lines.en: : Molly was never making me sad. I just...needed time to think about some things.
lines.zh: : Molly 从来没有让我难过。我只是……需要时间想一些事情。

lines.en: scene amidatecafe1
: Molly’s so pretty. Isn’t she, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Molly 好漂亮。是不是,Sensei?

lines.en: : Her skin is so pale and soft...and her eyes are so blue that you can get lost in them if you stare for too long.
lines.zh: : 她的皮肤又白又软……她的眼睛蓝得吓人,盯着看久了会陷进去。

lines.en: : What are you getting at?
lines.zh: : 你到底想说什么?

lines.en: : Nothing~ Just thinking about running away with her and stuff.
lines.zh: : 没什么~ 就是想着跟她私奔什么的。

lines.en: : Well, make sure to write if you do. I’ll be renting out your room for extra money.
lines.zh: : 行,真私奔的话记得写信。你的房间我要租出去赚外快。

lines.en: scene amidatecafe3
: Just like that?! You’re not even going to try and get me to stay?!
lines.zh: : 就这样?!你都不打算挽回一下?!

lines.en: : Also, never joke about renting out my room! I can hear Ayane unzipping her wallet as we speak!
lines.zh: : 还有,不许拿「出租我的房间」开玩笑!我现在都能听见 Ayane 拉开钱包拉链的声音!

lines.en: : Is it safe to say we’re moving on now? Or are you going to keep trying to ruin the date you literally forced me to come on?
lines.zh: : 现在可以往前走了吗?还是你要继续毁掉你半强迫我参加的这场约会?

lines.en: scene amidatecafe8
: We can move on...I don’t want to ruin anything.
lines.zh: : 可以往前走了……我不想毁掉任何东西。

lines.en: : I just get kinda jealous when I’m not in the loop and it feels like there have been a lot more loops than normal lately.
lines.zh: : 我只是圈外的时候会有点嫉妒,而且最近「圈外」的次数好像比平时多了很多。

lines.en: : But you can talk to me about stuff if you ever need advice, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 但你要是需要建议,Sensei,随时可以找我聊。

lines.en: scene amidatecafe9
: If it’s something involving you, you can pretty much guarantee that I’m the number one person to come to! I’d put more care into advice for you than I would for even myself!
lines.zh: : 只要那件事涉及我,你基本可以保证我是头号顾问!给你出的主意,我会比给自己的还上心!

lines.en: : That’s bad and you should always prioritize yourself over other people.
lines.zh: : 这样不对,你应该永远把自己放在别人前面。

lines.en: : I refuse!
lines.zh: : 我拒绝!

lines.en: : You need to be happy or my entire existence is meaningless!
lines.zh: : 你必须幸福,否则我的整个存在都没有意义!

lines.en: : I can’t imagine your parents would have been very happy to hear that while you were talking to them earlier.
lines.zh: : 我无法想象刚才你还在跟父母说话,就说出这种话,他们会高兴。

lines.en: scene amidatecafe10
: Oh. Uhh...Can you maybe...stop joking about them like that?
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……能不能……别拿他们开这种玩笑?

lines.en: : I’m obviously trying to be a little more open about what happened, but...I’d prefer if we could still be kind of sensitive about it.
lines.zh: : 我显然在努力更坦然地面对那件事,但是……我希望我们对它还是可以稍微敏感一点。

lines.en: : Today was a big step for me. And even though you were there to hold my hand, I’m going to keep working at it so I can maybe walk on my own some day.
lines.zh: : 对我来说,今天是巨大的一步。虽然有你握着我的手,但我还会继续努力,说不定哪天就能自己走了。

lines.en: : Sure. I didn’t really mean it as a joke. I-
lines.zh: : 好。我没想把它当笑话。我——

lines.en: : I know, I know. Sudden mentions of them just throw me off.
lines.zh: : 我知道,我知道。突然提到他们,我就会乱。

lines.en: : Like, it doesn’t completely register that they’re gone until after the sentence registers.
lines.zh: : 就是说,话都说完了,我才反应过来他们已经不在了。

lines.en: : It’s like there’s another mini accident inside of my mind each time I- nope. Nope. Don’t want to think about this anymore.
lines.zh: : 每次都会像……在我脑子里又发生一次小型车祸——不。不。我不想再想这个了。

lines.en: : Then think about something else. Like how you haven’t even touched your food yet and I’m already finished eating.
lines.zh: : 那就想想别的。比如你的饭一口没动,而我已经吃完了。

lines.en: scene amidatecafe11
: Oh my God, already? Who are you, Maya?
lines.zh: : 我的天,这就吃完了?你是谁,Maya 吗?

lines.en: : It’s not like we just sat down. We’ve been here for a while. In fact, I wouldn’t be surprised if your food was already cold.
lines.zh: : 也不是刚坐下。我们在这待了挺久了。说实话,你的饭凉了都不奇怪。

lines.en: scene amidatecafe12
: Has it really been that long?...
lines.zh: : 真的过了那么久吗?……

lines.en: : Sorry, I’m just...
lines.zh: : 抱歉,我只是……

lines.en: : I’m a little nervous because there’s something I’ve been wanting to show you...and I don’t think I’m really gonna get a better time than this date to do that.
lines.zh: : 我有点紧张,因为有一样东西我一直想给你看……而我想,不会有比今天这场约会更好的时机了。

lines.en: Ami curls her fingers around the base of her ponytail and begins to bob it up and down.
lines.zh: Ami 的手指卷住马尾的根部,开始上下晃。

lines.en: I’ve seen her do this in the past when she gets nervous- which is strange since she’s been twintailed for the majority of the time I’ve spent with her and I’ve never seen her do it then.
lines.zh: 她紧张时我见过她这么做——奇怪的是,我和她相处的大部分时间里她都是双马尾,从来没见她那时这么做。

lines.en: Either way, I can tell that she’s being honest again. I just don’t know what it is that she’d get so nervous about telling me when, if anything, she’s one of the most commonly open people I know.
lines.zh: 总之,我看得出来她又说了实话。我只是不知道,像她这种我认识的人里最藏不住话的,到底有什么事紧张成这样。

lines.en: : Is the thing you’ve been wanting to show me the next stop on our trip?
lines.zh: : 你想给我看的东西,是我们行程的下一站吗?

lines.en: : No...it’s actually...something I have on me now.
lines.zh: : 不……其实……是我现在随身带着的东西。

lines.en: : So...a present?
lines.zh: : 那么……是礼物?

lines.en: : Not really...but...also kind of?
lines.zh: : 不算……但……也算?

lines.en: : I don’t know. It’s probably dumb.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。可能挺蠢的。

lines.en: : You’re right. It probably is.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。多半是。

lines.en: scene amidatecafe13
: Hey!
: You’re supposed to say, “It won’t be dumb if it comes from you, Ami! You’re amazing and pretty!”
lines.zh: : 你应该说,「只要是 Ami 送的就不蠢!你又棒又漂亮!」

lines.en: : You’re pretty, yeah. But you’re also kind of an idiot.
lines.zh: : 漂亮是真的。但你也有点傻。

lines.en: scene amidatecafe14
: You’re my idiot, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你是「我的」傻瓜。

lines.en: : Which is a weird thing to say since I’m technically claiming ownership of you and I don’t technically enjoy being a legal guardian-
lines.zh: : 这话说出来有点怪,毕竟这在法律上等于宣布了对你的所有权,而我在法律上其实并不享受当监护人这件事——

lines.en: : But it is what it is.
lines.zh: : 但事情就是这样。

lines.en: scene amidatecafe15
: How did you manage to turn calling me an idiot into one of the sweetest things you’ve ever said to me?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么把「骂我傻瓜」变成你对我说过最甜的一句话的?

lines.en: : I’ve always had a way with words, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我大概天生就会说话吧。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: And that’s exactly why I’m so nervous about this.
lines.zh: : 而这正是我为此紧张的原因。

lines.en: : What do you-
lines.zh: : 你想干什——

lines.en: scene amidatecafe16
Ami slides a sheet of paper out of the bag she’d been keeping by her feet and holds it out in front of her.
lines.zh: Ami 从一直放在脚边的包里抽出一张纸,举到自己面前。

lines.en: Her eyes scan the page for an excuse to back down, but I guess they aren’t able to uncover any as she remains silent apart from the audible tapping of her feet underneath the table.
lines.zh: 她的目光在纸面上来回扫,想找个台阶下;但看来一无所获——除了桌下 audible 的脚尖点地声,她一言不发。
: 那么……

lines.en: : Believe it or not, I’ve never been very good at expressing my feelings.
lines.zh: : 信不信由你,我从来都不擅长表达自己的感情。

lines.en: : I don’t believe that at all. All you do is express your feelings.
lines.zh: : 这我完全不信。你做的所有事,就只剩表达感情了。

lines.en: scene amidatecafe17
: I know that. But it...never feels like I can properly get everything that I’m trying to say out.
lines.zh: : 我知道。但……我总觉得,我想说的话,从来都没法完整地说出来。

lines.en: : And I don’t think I will today either, but...I remember you telling me something a long time ago about how poems were how people like that could find a way to survive in this world.
lines.zh: : 今天大概也不行,但是……我记得很久以前,你跟我说过:像我这样的人,可以靠诗在这个世界上活下去。

lines.en: : It didn’t make much sense at the time since I was just a kid...but I think I kind of understand it now.
lines.zh: : 当时我太小,没听懂……但我想,我现在多少明白了。

lines.en: : So I thought I’d give it a try.
lines.zh: : 所以我想试一试。

lines.en: : It’s just kinda nerve wracking since I know you were like...a poetry expert a long time ago.
lines.zh: : 就是有点紧张,毕竟你以前可是……诗歌专家。

lines.en: : You...wrote me a poem?
lines.zh: : 你……给我写了一首诗?

lines.en: scene amidatecafe18
: I...tried to.
lines.zh: : 我……试着写了。

lines.en: : I don’t know if it’s any good, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我不知道写得好不好。

lines.en: : Well, that’s...unexpected.
lines.zh: : 嗯,这倒是……出乎意料。

lines.en: : How come?
lines.zh: : 哪里意外?

lines.en: : You’ve just never seemed like the “writer” type to me.
lines.zh: : 在我印象里,你从来不是「写作者」那一型。

lines.en: : Right. I’m the “idiot” type to you.
lines.zh: : 是哦,在你眼里我是「傻瓜」那一型。

lines.en: : But I tried really hard, so...
lines.zh: : 但我真的很努力地写了,所以……

lines.en: scene amidatecafe19
: Here goes nothing.
lines.zh: : 豁出去了。

lines.en: Ami stops tapping her feet and focuses whatever energy she was using on that to stabilize her hands.
lines.zh: Ami 停下脚尖点地,把那份精力挪去稳住双手。

lines.en: It’s easy to spot her nerves with how much the paper she wrote this on is trembling, and I’m sure she notices this as well as she needs to readjust her fingers a few times just to be able to read it.
lines.zh: 她写的这张纸抖得有多厉害,她的紧张就有多明显;我确信她也注意到了——她不得不调整了好几次手指,才能读清上面的字。

lines.en: I’m not sure what to expect, but I know now that however bad it is, I’m going to have to make sure that she thinks it’s good.
lines.zh: 我不知道该期待什么,但我现在知道:无论它有多糟,我都得让她觉得它很好。

lines.en: Such is the job of an [uncle]. And such is the job of-
lines.zh: 这就是 [uncle] 的职责。也是——

lines.en: : I named this poem “My Life With You.”
lines.zh: : 我给这首诗起名叫《与你共度的日子》。

lines.en: : A room full of sunshine, blacked out by a sheet.\nIt was there you and I were destined to meet.
lines.zh:
: 一整个房间的阳光,被一张床单遮蔽。
就是在那里,你与我的相遇早已注定。

lines.en: : Not for the first time, you’ve been there from the start.\nBut that room full of sunshine filled a hole in my heart.
lines.zh:
: 并非初见——你却从一开始就在。
那满屋的阳光,填上我心口的洞。

lines.en: : We both couldn’t see it, but we knew it was there.\nSo with holes in our clothing and knots in our hair-
lines.zh:
: 我们都看不见它,却知道它一直都在。
于是衣衫褴褛、发丝打结的我们——

lines.en: : We’d get out of bed for just minutes each day.\nWe didn’t speak much, there was nothing to say.
lines.zh:
: 每天只离开床铺短短几分钟。
我们无话可说,所以也几乎不说话。

lines.en: : But one day that changed and the dark disappeared.\nWe took down that sheet and we faced what we feared.
lines.zh:
: 直到某天,一切都变了,黑暗消散。
我们取下床单,直面各自的恐惧。

lines.en: : You became my world, since the old one was gone.\nThen one day it hit me, like I’d known all along.
lines.zh:
: 旧世界已然消逝,你成了我的全世界。
直到某天恍然惊觉,仿佛我早就明白。

lines.en: : No sheet can contain the light from the sun.\nAnd all darkness must die once daylight’s begun.
lines.zh:
: 没有什么床单,能困住太阳的光。
一旦天亮,所有黑暗都必须消亡。

lines.en: : I guess it sounds silly, but I know that it’s true.
lines.zh:
: 听起来也许傻气,但我知道那是真的。
一整个房间的阳光——那就是我和你的日子。

lines.en: : A room full of sunshine- that’s my life with you.

lines.zh: : 铛铛。我爱你。

lines.en: scene amidatecafe20
: Ta-da. I love you.
lines.zh: : 刚才那个……

lines.en: : That was...
lines.zh: : 等等。我不确定我做好了被嘲笑的准备。我知道它很烂,但我真的很努力——

lines.en: scene amidatecafe21
: Wait. I don’t know if I’m ready to be made fun of yet. I know it was bad, but I worked really hard and-
lines.zh: : 不,Ami。它比我预想的好太多了。

lines.en: : No, Ami. That was way better than I expected.
lines.zh: : 真的……吗?

lines.en: scene amidatecafe22
: It...was?
lines.zh: : 但你这么说,只是因为你原本毫无期待吧?我随便念点什么,都会比你的预期好。

lines.en: : But you’re only saying that because you expected literally nothing, right? Like I could have said anything and it would have been better than what you were expecting.
lines.zh: : 不,我是真心喜欢,而且我很佩服你能写出那个。

lines.en: : No, I mean I genuinely liked it and I’m really impressed you were able to write that.
lines.zh: 我只是希望自己能再多沐浴一会儿——沐浴在它与我同 Ami 这段关系的呼应之中。

lines.en: scene amidatecafe23
I just wish that I could bask a little longer in the relevancy it has pertaining to my relationship with Ami.
lines.zh: 我确信那一天终究会来,我也确信那些回忆终会想法子溜回我的脑海。

lines.en: I’m sure that day will come eventually, and I’m sure those memories may find a way to sneak back into my mind.
lines.zh: 但至少现在,我只能把她的诗当作它字面上的样子,连同它附带的所有含义。

lines.en: But for now, I’ll have to take her words for nothing more than their face value and the connotations tied to them.
lines.zh: 尽管这一切仍显得有点超现实——

lines.en: And even though it all still seems a little surreal-
lines.zh: 我想,我现在更明白 Ami 对我的感情从何而来了。

lines.en: I think I better understand why Ami feels the way she does about me now.
lines.zh: 只是,这实在算不上一个好理由。

lines.en: It’s just not a very good reason.
lines.zh: : 你真的喜欢?!你不觉得我是个失败者、觉得我该立刻放弃诗歌?!

lines.en: : You really liked it?! You don’t think I’m a failure and that I should give up on poetry immediately?!
lines.zh: : 我不觉得。

lines.en: : I don’t.
lines.zh: : 事实上,我觉得你应该多写。

lines.en: : In fact, I think you should write more.
lines.zh: : 我的天,Sensei……你不知道听到这句话,我有多如释重负。

lines.en: scene amidatecafe24
: Oh my God, Sensei...you have no idea how much of a relief it is to hear that.
lines.zh: : 你真以为听完那个,我会直接叫你放弃?

lines.en: : Did you really think I was going to just tell you to quit after hearing that?
lines.zh: : 有一点点……

lines.en: scene amidatecafe25
: A little...
lines.zh: : 这首诗是我不久前写的……昨晚整理妈妈遗物的时候,我翻到了一堆她旧日的诗,想起你有多喜欢它们。

lines.en: : I wrote this a little while ago, but...when I was going through some of Mom’s stuff last night, I found a bunch of her old poetry and remembered how much you liked it.
lines.zh: : 我从前一直不懂诗到底有什么好,但现在重读那些诗……我想我终于懂了。

lines.en: : I never really understood what the appeal of poems was back then, but reading them now...I think I finally get it.
lines.zh: : 她的笔触是那么……嗯……优雅?优雅这个词对吗?

lines.en: : She had such an...um...eloquent way of writing? Is eloquent the right word?

lines.zh: : 你看这样行不行:我拍了一张照片,念给你听,你来判断我是不是走对了路。

lines.en: scene amidatecafe26
: You know what? I’ll just read one that I took a picture of and you can let me know if I’m on the right track.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定,它一定会显得我的诗特别烂,毕竟她基本上是专业人士,但是——

lines.en: : I’m sure that it’ll make my poem sound like, really bad since she was basically a pro, but-
scene spiderbug
scene amidatecafe27
: Ah.
lines.zh: Ami 的手机脱手,在桌上弹了一下,撞上旁边的空玻璃杯。

lines.en: Ami drops her phone and it bounces off the table into the side of an empty glass.
lines.zh: 那只杯子曾经盛过水,但它再也不会盛任何东西了。

lines.en: The glass once held water, but it will never hold anything again.
lines.zh: 我看着碎裂的瞬间,仿佛我的世界被切成了慢动作。

lines.en: I watch the shattering as if my world is plunged into slow motion.
lines.zh: 每一片碎片飞向不同的方向,有的飞得远,有的飞得近,毫无缘由可循。

lines.en: Each shard moves in a different direction, some moving more distance than others without rhyme or reason as to why.
lines.zh: 我相信这背后必有科学解释,但我更愿意把它想象成纯粹的概率。

lines.en: I am sure there is a scientific explanation for it, but I’d prefer to imagine it’s just random chance.
lines.zh: 邻桌的客人也被吸引,驻足围观,同样看得入神。

lines.en: A nearby table joins in on the action and watches on, mesmerized as well.
lines.zh: 破碎之中总有一种美,能引来形形色色的看客。

lines.en: There is something beautiful about being broken that attracts all sorts of onlookers.
lines.zh: 我身边碎掉的东西那么多,而吸引最多目光的偏偏是那只杯子,我为此感到庆幸。

lines.en: I am glad the glass is what attracted most when there is so much that is broken all around me.
scene amidatecafe28
: Huh? What happened to my phone? I was just-
lines.zh: : 咦?我的手机怎么了?我刚才只是——

lines.en: scene amidatecafe29
: Wait, what happened to that glass?!
lines.zh: : 等等,那个杯子怎么回事?!

lines.en: : Do you really not remember?
lines.zh: : 你真的不记得了?

lines.en: scene amidatecafe30
: Remember what? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 记得什么?你在说什么?

lines.en: : You...literally dropped your phone into the glass just a few seconds ago.
lines.zh: : 你……几秒钟前刚刚把手机摔进那个杯子里。

lines.en: : I...did?
: Yeah...are you feeling okay?
lines.zh: : 对……你感觉还好吗?

lines.en: scene amidatecafe31
: Yeah. I feel totally fine. I...I have to clean that up, though. Somebody could get hurt.
lines.zh: : 挺好。我完全没事。只是……我得把那个清理掉。会有人受伤的。

lines.en: : I’ll just flag down our waitress. I’m sure they have someone who-
lines.zh: : 我叫服务员来就行。他们肯定有专门的人——

lines.en: : No! That’s not fair to them.
lines.zh: : 不行!那样对他们不公平。

lines.en: : It’s my fault this happened. Besides, I’ve cleaned up a lot worse than this.
lines.zh: : 是我闯的祸。再说,比这难收拾得多的事故我都收拾过。

lines.en: scene amidatecafe32
: But I guess I probably don’t have to explain that since my poem probably...reminded you of...anyway, yeah. I’m going to clean up the glass now.
lines.zh: : 不过,这个大概不用我解释——我的诗多半让你想起了……总之,对。我现在去把玻璃清掉。

lines.en: : I’m sorry for causing a scene, Sensei. I know how much you hate being the center of attention.
lines.zh: : 抱歉引来了围观,Sensei。我知道你有多讨厌成为焦点。

lines.en: : It’s fine...
lines.zh: : 没事……

lines.en: : Are you really sure you’re okay, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你真的没事吗?

lines.en: : I have to clean up the glass.
lines.zh: : 我得去把玻璃清掉。

lines.en: scene black
Ami bends down and begins to scoop the shards of glass into her hands.
lines.zh: Ami 弯下腰,开始把玻璃碎片捧进手心。

lines.en: I wonder if she, too, appreciates the beauty in how each and every one of them is unique.
lines.zh: 我不知道,她是否也欣赏着每一片碎片的独一无二。

lines.en: I wonder if she, too, acknowledges how tragic it is that the object is now devoid of all purpose.
lines.zh: 我不知道,她是否也承认——这件东西如今失去了所有用途,是多么可悲。

lines.en: She cuts her hands as she cleans up the accident.
lines.zh: 她清理这场事故时,划破了手。

lines.en: It reminds me of something.
lines.zh: 这让我想起了一件事。

$ amidate50p3 = True
jump amidate50p4
